chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Rib'i, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Does a man give the Adhan while sitting?' He said, 'Yes, but he does not give the Iqamah unless he is standing.'

key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: to give the Adhan (call to prayer)
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: to give the Iqamah (announcement for prayer)

ai.seo_question: Can a man give the Adhan while sitting in Islam?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) delineates the distinct juristic requirements for the Adhan and Iqamah, permitting the former to be recited while seated due to its length and optional nature, while mandating standing for the Iqamah to signify the immediate readiness for prayer. This distinction highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the physical posture as a marker of the transition from announcement to the actual commencement of the congregational prayer.
